about.funding: Every temple on the platform is run on devotee contributions. Every lamp lit, every plate served and every priest’s honorarium comes from a family that chose to give.
about.hoursNote: Timings can change on festival days — check the calendar.
about.platform: Shree Saibaba brings Sai temples together on one simple platform: live darshan and aartis, the Thursday vrat, pujas offered in your family’s name, and gifts that are reported openly. Baba asked for two things — Shraddha (faith) and Saburi (patience) — and everyone who shares them is welcome here, whatever their religion or background.
about.subtitle: A home for devotees of Sai Baba, of every faith, in every country.
about.taxNote: Receipts follow the tax rules of the temple’s own country. Amounts are always shown in that temple’s currency and never converted.

vrat.whatIsBody: Devotees observe nine (or eleven) consecutive Thursdays with morning prayer, a lamp, flowers, a simple offering and a few minutes of reading or chanting. It is taken up with a wish in the heart, or simply in gratitude, and is closed with a small thanksgiving called udyapan.
